name: EvilEye-TS-TW

frames.best_why: The iris ring, slit pupil and outer flame are all sharp and evenly lit here.

tagline: A fiery orange eye with a slit pupil glares from the dark.
summary: A wide ellipse of orange flame draws a single eye on black, with fibrous rays around a dark vertical slit. The flame ripples and the pupil slides toward the pointer.
appearance: A stretched horizontal eye shape built from hundreds of fine orange and amber filaments, brightest in a ring around the middle. The pupil is a narrow black slit at the centre, and the edges break into ragged tongues of fire.
behaviour: The filament ring churns and flares continuously like fire. As the pointer moves, the pupil drifts toward it and settles back to the middle when the pointer leaves.
search_phrases: evil eye with fire around it
glowing eye that follows the cursor
creepy glowing eye for a game page
use_when: A dark fantasy or horror page needs a single menacing focal graphic.
avoid_when: You need something friendly or brand-neutral: the orange fire and slit pupil are strongly sinister.
customise: Eye colour, intensity, pupil size, iris width, glow, scale, noise, pupil follow, flame speed and background colour are props. The eye's shape is fixed in the shader.
weight_why: A full-screen shader samples a generated noise texture every frame.

a11y.note: Decorative canvas with no text alternative and no reduced-motion check for the constant flame motion.

polish_why: Detailed, convincing fire with a clear pupil; the symmetrical shape reads slightly flat.
title: Evil Eye
